guides.title: No STT · Recognition
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.
learning_outcomes: Choose a transcription backend only when needed

steps.title: Recognize the None option
steps.body: None intentionally disables microphone speech recognition. Typed chat and configured spoken replies can still work. This option has no recognition model to configure or load. Read the active-backend indicator to distinguish viewing None from selecting it for the session.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Distinguish viewed and active backends
steps.body: Viewing None does not make it the active STT backend. Read the active indicator before diagnosing microphone activity. When None is active, this transcription route is disabled; other features may still capture audio independently. If you later want transcription, follow the separate STT setup guide.
